t: Review of Tianzifang | Shanghai, China, Asia - AFAR
s: July 25, 2024 - Shanghai's arts and crafts enclave, Tianzifang, is a labyrinth of narrow lanes bursting with diminutive shops, restaurants, and bars. Most of the shops here are located inside shikumen, stone gatehouses dating to the early 1930s. Gear up for your shopping spree with a coffee alfresco at Kommune before checking out Xingmu Handicraft's gorgeous handmade leather notebooks or Shanghai Code's vintage Chinese glasses and watches.
